title: Finite-Time Node Separation in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks with Persistent Gaussian Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2609.13920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent Gaussian perturbations have been shown to prevent asymptotic oversmoothing in recurrent Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) by ensuring a positive stationary Dirichlet energy. However, this global energy bound does not guarantee that individual node representations remain distinct at finite depths. In this paper, we provide a complementary finite-time analysis of the same persistent-noise architecture. Let \(d\) denote the representation dimension and \(\sigma\) the noise standard deviation. We first prove an exact second-moment decomposition for the expected squared distance between any two node representations, yielding the universal lower bound \(2\sigma^2 d\) at every positive time step without contraction or stationarity assumptions. More precisely, conditional pairwise distances have a noncentral chi-square characterization: the noncentrality parameter is the deterministic message-passing separation normalized by \(2\sigma^2\

translated_title: 带有持续高斯扰动的循环图神经网络中的有限时间节点分离
translated_abstract: 持续高斯扰动已被证明可以通过确保正的稳态狄利克雷能量来防止循环图神经网络（GNN）中的渐近过平滑。然而，这种全局能量界并不能保证各个节点表示在有限深度处仍然保持区分。在本文中，我们对相同的持续噪声架构提供了互补的有限时间分析。设 \(d\) 表示表示维度，\(\sigma\) 表示噪声标准差。我们首先证明了任意两个节点表示之间的期望平方距离的精确二阶矩分解，从而得到在每个正时间步长处均成立的通用下界 \(2\sigma^2 d\)，且无需收缩性或平稳性假设。更准确地说，条件成对距离具有非中心卡方分布的刻画：其非中心参数是由 \(2\sigma^2\) 归一化的确定性消息传递分离……
tldr: 本文证明了带有持续高斯扰动的循环图神经网络中，任意两个节点表示之间的期望平方距离在每个正时间步长均存在 \(2\sigma^2 d\) 的通用下界，从而保证了有限深度下节点表示的分离性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a universal lower bound of 2σ²d on the expected squared distance between any two node representations at every positive time step in recurrent GNNs with persistent Gaussian perturbations, guaranteeing node separation at finite depths.
